senses.gloss: how much?, how many? Kidd. 9ᵇ ב׳ אתה נותן וכ׳ how much (dowry) wilt thou give &c.? Ber. 14ᵃ עד כ׳ up to how much? Ib. 30ᵇ כ׳ ישהה וכ׳ how long must he pause between &c.?; a. fr.
how!, how many!, how much! Sabb. 12ᵇ כ׳ גדולים דברי וכ׳ how grand are the words of &c.; a. fr.—על אחת כ׳ וכ׳, v. אֶחָד.

units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 16b:24">M. Kat. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>איבדתי כ׳ דוד מפניו</he> I should have destroyed many Davids for his sake.
